comment: A backend test FILE is routed to the serialized lane (canonical DB primeclassy_testing, run alone, after the parallel phase) when ANY rule matches, or when listed in path_overrides. Rules are static text heuristics; they are conservative, not proofs. Review the manifest's serial_reasons.

rules.reason: Spawns real PHP actor processes. ConcurrencyHarness::actorEnvironment() hard-codes DB_DATABASE=TestDatabaseGuard::DATABASE (primeclassy_testing) and its runtime dir is not worker-scoped, so actors would hit the wrong DB / shared dir.
Asserts the exact canonical database name / run-lock semantics or spawns probe scripts bound to it.
Non-comment reference to the literal canonical DB name; cannot be proven worker-safe statically.
Writes/deletes a fixed path under storage/framework/testing shared by every process.
The command refuses --apply unless the database name ends in _test/_testing (RefundLedgerBackfill safety rule); worker databases end in _wN, so these tests run on the canonical database.
Exercises schema-fingerprint internals against the canonical database.
